answer: Each identity locks 60 copper plus a 5 fee. Copper units carry tags on the river ledger. Fresh units back one identity. A reused unit must pass the delta foundry, paying 10 for a second backing, 20 for a third, and 10 more per further backing. The k-th fake still costs at least 65, while cycling one pool through 1,000 identities would owe about 5,000,000 in recast fees, versus 65,000 for fresh bonds. An honest agent pays 65 once. A recast ring fails because reused tags show on the river ledger, the foundry recomputes the fee due, and underpayment burns the bond and revokes the identity.
